name: Wild Garden
description: Nature attuned: Poison you apply lasts 2 extra ticks.

name: Verdant Cycle
description: Nature attuned: At each Cycle start, gain 3 Regeneration.

name: Rising Tide
description: Water attuned: Every third Water spell grants 2 Tide.

name: Reservoir
description: Water attuned: Start combat with 3 Tide.

name: Inferno
description: Fire attuned: Spending 5 Heat makes your next Fire spell 1T faster.

name: Sacred Rhythm
description: Holy attuned: Completing an Oath Empowers your next Holy spell.

name: Venomous Hex
description: Nature attuned: Applying Slow also applies 2 Poison.

name: Steam
description: Fire attuned: After Water, a Fire spell gains 2 Heat before resolving.

name: Wildfire
description: Nature + Fire attuned: Applying Poison while you have Heat also deals 20 damage.

name: Purifying Rain
description: After Holy, a Water spell grants 45 Ward.

name: Blighted Tide
description: Nature + Water attuned: Spending Tide extends existing enemy Poison by 2 ticks.

name: First Strike
description: Your first spell each Cycle deals 50% more direct damage.

name: Finisher
description: Your final spell each Cycle is Empowered.

name: Echo Chamber
description: Every fourth completed spell resolves twice.

name: Alternation
description: Changing domains gives the next spell 20% more damage, healing and Ward.

name: Crescendo
description: Each preceding spell this Cycle adds 5% direct damage.

name: Opening Ward
description: Your first spell each Cycle grants 50 Ward.

name: Heavy Hitter
description: Printed 3T spells deal 40% more direct damage.

name: Rapid Casting
description: Every third printed 1T spell repeats at half power.

name: Patience
description: Completing a printed 3T spell grants 80 Ward.

name: Momentum
description: Three consecutive printed 1T spells make your next 2T+ spell 1T faster.

name: Glass Cannon
description: Deal 30% more damage. Maximum Health is reduced by 125.

name: Blood Magic
description: Self-damage adds 50 direct damage to your next completed spell.

name: Last Stand
description: Below 30% Health, spells start 1T faster (minimum 1T).

name: Reckless Loop
description: Skip the reshuffle tick. Lose 25 Health at each new Cycle.

name: Second Wind
description: Once per combat, reaching 30% Health restores 120 Health.

name: Specialist
description: Your most common domain has triple shop weight.

name: Wanderer
description: Domains absent from your deck have triple shop weight.

name: Recycler
description: Trashing a spell refunds 1 gold.

name: Scholar
description: Your first purchased duplicate each shop grants 2 XP instead of 1.

name: Scavenger
description: Your first reroll each shop is free.

name: Deep Pockets
description: Receive 4 extra gold whenever you enter a new shop.
